metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds an afternoon at home, three nights named, and new hose of the stock.

yesterday: Titus was the afternoon, and you were at home. You went at five.

St Stephen's is the Navarre comedy, new to the Queen. St John's is the lovers, ten days old by then, and Richard has the second night, for a house that has supped. Innocents' is Errors, in place of Two Gentlemen.
Garnish is to cut the lovers to two hours and a half. The thumb-biting in the first scene goes. After the copying of the fourth, you change a line only if a playing fault demands it.
The Master's rehearsal is the sixteenth, at Clerkenwell. Heminges and Bryan are named for the money. The money is still to come into the house.
New hose, the whole company, of the stock, and nobody named a price. The heel my lord saw is nobody's in particular. Cowley was out of the room.
Nobody is to startle Nick. That was said again, and he was out of the room.
You did not offer the wood-play. It is three pages and a speech, and wanting it does not finish it.
